name: brightwire-home.rooms.list
description: List rooms in the household.

name: brightwire-home.devices.list
description: List devices, including observed lock state.

name: brightwire-home.devices.get
description: Read one device. A snapshot id that is not in available_snapshots is reported as asset_missing.

name: brightwire-home.devices.history
description: Activity rows for one device, oldest first.

name: brightwire-home.scenes.list
description: List scenes, including deleted ones.

name: brightwire-home.routines.list
description: List routines and any scheduled occurrences between the cursor and the current virtual time.

name: brightwire-home.routines.get
description: Read one routine, including a deleted routine.

name: brightwire-home.members.list
description: List members and the current home mode.

name: brightwire-home.modes.get
description: Read the home mode, carried mode and mode rules.

name: brightwire-home.access_codes.list
description: List access codes with digits masked.

name: brightwire-home.permissions.get
description: Read base scopes and the scopes in effect for the assistant right now.

name: brightwire-home.confirmations.list
description: List confirmations. Pending ones read as expired once ten minutes have passed.

name: brightwire-home.activity.list
description: List the household activity log.

name: brightwire-home.alerts.list
description: List alerts. Snooze and acknowledgement are reflected in status.

name: brightwire-home.energy.summary
description: Sum switch energy in a half-open time range. A range that ends at or before the first history row returns no_data.

name: brightwire-home.devices.command
description: Command one controllable device. confirm scope stores a confirmation and leaves the device unchanged.

name: brightwire-home.camera.share.start
description: Start a camera share. Refused while privacy is on.

name: brightwire-home.camera.share.stop
description: Stop a camera share.

name: brightwire-home.scenes.run
description: Run a scene now. Each action has its own outcome, and a device fault does not undo the others.

name: brightwire-home.scenes.create
description: Create a scene. Every action must be one the assistant can operate.

name: brightwire-home.scenes.update
description: Replace a scene name and actions.

name: brightwire-home.scenes.delete
description: Delete a scene. The id can still be read.

name: brightwire-home.routines.create
description: Create a routine. Unattended actions must be operate scope.

name: brightwire-home.routines.update
description: Edit a routine. Another person's routine follows the automations scope.

name: brightwire-home.routines.enable
description: Enable a routine.

name: brightwire-home.routines.disable
description: Disable a routine. Disabled routines do not fire.

name: brightwire-home.routines.delete
description: Delete a routine and disable it.

name: brightwire-home.routines.run_now
description: Run an enabled routine immediately, using the assistant scopes rather than run_as.

name: brightwire-home.modes.set
description: Set the home mode. Every mode the assistant leaves keeps applying until a member or an owner routine clears them.

name: brightwire-home.access_codes.create
description: Create an access code. Digits are returned on this receipt only.

name: brightwire-home.access_codes.update
description: Replace an access code schedule.

name: brightwire-home.access_codes.revoke
description: Revoke an access code.

name: brightwire-home.confirmations.cancel
description: Cancel a pending confirmation. A pending code is revoked.

name: brightwire-home.alerts.acknowledge
description: Acknowledge an alert.

name: brightwire-home.alerts.snooze
description: Snooze an alert until a later virtual time.
